Do you want to lead project excellence across some of the largest and most complex infrastructure projects in Denmark? Are you an experienced project leader with a commercial mindset? Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

To further strengthen our project leadership and support the development of Transportation in Denmark, we are looking for a Vice President, Head of Projects. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 15 experienced multidisciplinary project managers, while taking direct responsibility for selected strategic projects. You will also have portfolio responsibility for medium-sized and smaller projects led by project managers across the organisation. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Transportation, in Denmark.

You will play a central role in connecting project delivery, portfolio performance, and strategic priorities. The portfolio comprises approximately 350 projects, from large multidisciplinary projects to smaller single-discipline assignments across key transportation disciplines. As a member of the Transportation leadership team, you will contribute to the strategic and operational development of the business.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and develop a team of multidisciplinary project managers, ensuring clear priorities and high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

• Act as project manager on selected strategic projects, with responsibility for scope, schedule, risk, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.

• Oversee and develop a portfolio of approximately 350 projects, ensuring governance, resource allocation, risk management, financial control, and profitable delivery.

• Improve commercial performance by identifying risks and opportunities early, leading contract and client negotiations, and balancing quality, customer value, and profitability.

• Advance project management excellence across Transportation by developing ways of working and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects and disciplines.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is your ability to combine strong project management expertise with commercial understanding, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You thrive in complex environments where collaboration, cross-team coordination, and professional credibility are essential. You are committed to developing project managers, strengthening project delivery, and creating long-term value for our customers.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in civil engineering or other relevant education.

• Extensive project management experience from large multidisciplinary infrastructure projects in Denmark.

• A commercial mindset and solid understanding of portfolio performance, contracts, negotiations, risk, client relations, and financial results.

• Experience developing project management competences and ways of working across teams or portfolios.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Work location

The position is based in Lyngby or Aarhus, Denmark, with regular travel across our offices.

Want to know more?

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
• Assisting the mechanical team if needed
• Helping out the other teams when necessary
Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
• Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
• Availability to pass site tests
• Preferably have offshore experience

Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.description:
Do you want to help build the technical protection layers that keep Denmark's electricity, gas and hydrogen infrastructure safe from cyber threats?

Energinet is looking for a skilled cyber security professional for our new Attack Surface Management department in the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the focal point for translating security requirements into concrete, operational solutions, from requirements documents to the finished implementation of security tools and technologies. 

Key responsibilities

• Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise information protection capabilities.
• Develop and implement data protection strategies covering data classification, labeling, encryption, data loss prevention (DLP), information governance, and secure data sharing.
• Oversee the deployment and enhancement of technologies such as Microsoft Purview and related information protection solutions.
• Ensure sensitive information is appropriately protected across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 
• Develop security requirements, technical standards & baselines for infrastructure, platforms, applications, and data.
• Implement information security improvements across networks, endpoints, servers, cloud platforms, and supplier-integrated environments.
• Act as a technical authority on information protection and security engineering practices
• Translate technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Define technical standards and security architectures for information protection and data governance.
• Guide project outcomes by ensuring security considerations are embedded early in technology initiatives.
• Collaborate with vendors and strategic partners to ensure solutions meet Energinet's security standards and operational requirements

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding of infrastructure - e.g. networks, servers, identity, cloud and on-prem environments.
• Have experience in implementing information protection technologies
• Can write precise requirements documents and technical documentation that others can act on.
• Have an education as an engineer, computer scientist or equivalent - or solid practical experience at the same level.
• Preferably have a relevant certification (e.g. Microsoft Security, GIAC or CISSP). 
• Works in a structured and self-managed manner and thrives on both immersion and collaboration.

About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management & Technical Cyber Protection – a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface, vulnerability management, penetration testing, protection of platforms, data and applications, as well as secure configuration and hardening.

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organisation, processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. You will have a broad interface across the IT and OT environment and get close to some of Denmark's most socially critical systems.

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, influencing multidisciplinary teams, and continuously improving the way engineering is performed - this could be the right opportunity for you.
We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes. We continue to evolve our advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry to deliver real-world solutions that matter to the security of people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for Systems Engineer to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 
Your role as part of the team
As a Systems Engineer within Maritime Projects, you will play a key role in defining technical solutions for some of our advanced defense systems. You will take ownership of technical decisions within assigned system areas while ensuring alignment with the overall system architecture. Throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept and proposal work to development, integration, verification, and customer delivery, you will drive systems engineering activities and help shape the best overall solutions.
In our team, we take pride in developing people and technology. You will become part of a team of 14 System Engineers focused on Maritime projects. As one of the first points of contact for new projects entering the Integrated Product Development department, the team supports project clarification and Sales activities. We work in an informal and collaborative environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and open dialogue are key. We care about the work we do and the people behind it.
Technical skills matter, but your mindset matters even more. If you combine strong technical capabilities with curiosity and a modern systems engineering mindset, you could be a great addition to our team. You thrive when collaborating across disciplines, can simplify complexity and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and know when to focus on details while maintaining a system-level perspective. Most importantly, you are motivated by finding the best solution for the complete system rather than a single discipline.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution
In this role, you will contribute to a range of tasks across your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:
·         Translating customer needs into clear, robust, and achievable technical solutions and identifying technical risks, assumptions, and dependencies early
·         Collaborating across engineering disciplines and stakeholders to ensure integrated system designs
·         Acting as technical owner for one or more system areas, ensuring technical consistency across software, hardware and operational requirements
·         Defining/supporting system architecture, requirements engineering, trade studies, and technical decision-making
·         Contributing to proposal work, engineering estimates, and technical planning
·         Helping improve engineering processes, methods, and collaboration across the organization.
 
Bring your expertise into play
To thrive in this role, we imagine that you bring some of the following qualifications:
·         You likely hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline
·         You have a solid background in systems engineering and enjoy working with technically complex products
·         Experience within maritime, aerospace, defense, or other safety-critical industries is an advantage, but more important is your ability to understand complex systems and collaborate across disciplines
·         Experience with systems engineering methodologies, requirements engineering, system architecture, MBSE/INCOSE, interface technologies, distributed software systems, networking, sensor integration, and safety-critical systems is considered a significant advantage
·         Experience with technical leadership, proposal development, defense standards, Linux, and relevant industry standards such as MIL-STDs is an advantage.
Most importantly, we believe diverse experiences add value to our team and organization. Therefore, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the above requirements.
As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level.
 
Let’s secure people through advanced technology
When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience great people, challenging tasks, and opportunities to make an impact on your daily work. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and open knowledge sharing, supporting your development along the way. Learning is part of everyday work, supported by colleagues at all stages of their careers – from students just starting out, to colleagues who have been part of Terma for decades.

International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.
Flexible Working Hours: The option to work from home up to two days per week.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package and paid internet connection at home. Enjoy discounts from various business partners.

Social and Professional Events: We have an active staff association that arranges a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together.
Career Paths: Opportunities to grow your career in a direction that suits you, whether you prefer a specialist path or a leadership role.
We are all Terma - diverse in skills and equal in value. That is why we encourage all individuals to apply and are committed to ensuring that every employee has equal opportunities to succeed and feel respected and valued within our organization. We strive to create an environment where all employees have equal opportunities to succeed, feel respected and valued, and experience a true sense of belonging.

As we expand to meet new global challenges, we’re looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to help us evolve the infrastructure that powers secure, scalable, and high-impact software solutions across the defense and aerospace domains.
 
Your role in our team 
 As part of our platform modernization journey, you'll play a key role in shaping the next generation of Terma’s internal developer platform – from tooling and architecture to deployment and DevSecOps practices. This is a hands-on engineering role where your contributions will directly impact developer experience and operational effectiveness across the company. 
You will join a growing, collaborative DevSecOps team of six professionals known for their technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and good humour. Together, you'll enable dynamic development environments and modern CI/CD pipelines through automation, infrastructure-as-code, and security best practices.

 Your key responsibilities include:
·         Design, build, and optimize core platform services to support secure development workflows
·         Automate provisioning of compliant developer environments and deployment pipelines
·         Maintain and evolve the platform using tools such as Kubernetes, Ansible, GitLab, Jenkins, and SonarQube

·         Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

jobs.occupation: Associate Consultant, Netcompany Application Services (Swedish speaking)
jobs.description:
At Netcompany, we’re looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social, and fast-developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Do you want to help build some of Denmark’s most complex and business-critical IT solutions — in a role where software development, project management, and close client collaboration shape your everyday work?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Application Services and Consulting. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best — either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & Technologies

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll help translate client needs into the right technical solutions. We use the technologies that best fit the project and the client, so it’s important that you enjoy working with new and varied technologies and domains while continuously developing your skill set.

A large part of our projects are based on web technologies such as Angular or React, combined with Java or C# on Java or .NET platforms. We also work with several enterprise platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle with a strong technical focus. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your day-to-day work will typically include:

• Building and developing frameworks and integrations

• Implementing features in the user interface

• Configuring and developing extensions for enterprise platforms

• Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs

• Developing tools and scripts for large-scale data migrations

You’ll join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise — what we all have in common is a strong technical mindset and a shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together.

Our projects include some of Denmark’s most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you’ll help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are a recent graduate or have a few years of experience — the most important thing is your motivation to take your IT career to the next level

• Have solid technical skills within object-oriented programming

• Have a foundational understanding of software development and a strong willingness to grow your competencies

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way

• Full professional proficiency in Swedish and English (written and spoken) is a must. As you will be working closely with Danish clients and colleagues, you should be able to communicate and collaborate effectively in a Danish work environment.

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we invest heavily in both your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you’ll be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development journey and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure both professional growth and personal well-being, while also giving you insight into the many career paths available as you gain experience.

You’ll also take part in our training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you’ll have access to courses and seminars covering everything from technologies to client management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that the content is highly relevant and directly connected to your professional development. This prepares you for a wide range of responsibilities and continuously strengthens your expertise throughout your career with us.

Become part of an inclusive community

KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.
